paragraphs: Systems Engineer with a Master's degree in Integrated Management Systems and a specialization in Teaching and Pedagogy, with over 10 years of experience in higher education, technology training, and software engineering.
Specialist in programming education, cloud computing, and web application development, with experience in online learning environments and LMS platforms such as Moodle and Canvas.
Experienced as a university professor, bootcamp instructor, and software project leader, applying Agile methodologies (Scrum) and project-based learning approaches.
